data.headline: Senior Program Manager - Mergers and Acquisitions
data.about:
Business optimizer and value driver effective at creating and steering organizational value through the execution of strategic initiatives that capture operational excellence, quality, and supply management objectives. Reputation for driving breakthrough results and transformational change within operations with a transparent and authentic leadership approach.

Adept at managing and advocating change with a laser-focused approach to deliver on business goals and KPIs. Strong ability to analyze issues, define what success looks like, and lead strategies that solve challenges and improve cost performance. Versatile leader effective at fostering strong partnerships with stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and suppliers. Skilled at mobilizing high performing teams and leading the ‘why’ to capture significant business results.

subComponents.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager - Mergers and Acquisitions
subComponents.caption: Mar 2022 - Present · 3 yrs 10 mos

description.text: Represent Corporate Supplier Quality and Operations Quality on Mergers and Acquisitions team.  Plan and manage activities around Due Diligence, Post Acquisition Assessments, and Integration strategy and actions.  Develop standard processes and work around acquisition and integration activities and drive functional alignment and continuous improvement within the M&A teams.

subComponents.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Contract Manufacturing and OEM
subComponents.caption: Oct 2020 - Mar 2022 · 1 yr 5 mos

description.text:
Accountable for leading the strategic quality, delivery, and cost optimization initiatives across 16 Cardiac Surgery Contract Manufacturers and OEMs that manufacture 550+ MDT SKUs with annual volume surpassing 7.3M units and spend of ~$120M. Direct a team of 4 engineers and oversight of a $900K CAPEX budget within the General Surgery and Market Access (GSMA) business. Positioned on the MDT Corporate Enterprise Change Control Team as CM-OEM and SCC SME and Leader of the Rapid Response Team.
	Guided the long-range planning strategy, analyzing supplier capacity, performance, and quality objectives to drive greater clarity and supplier visibility.
	Partnered with key supplier to analyze root causes behind $2M+ in backorders, identifying challenges with communications and supply constraints – drove change and reduced backorders to less than $50K.
	Steered significant turn-around and greatly improved performance after a 36-month decline into extensive backorders, positioning operation as sustainable within first 9 months prior to the supply chain crisis.
	Actively navigating supply chain crisis, developing specific plans for the 20 priority products that account for 75% of business, implementing early warning systems and feedback loops to increase visibility and mitigate surprises.
	Selected by executive leadership to lead the newly formed Rapid Response Team to strategize and alleviate supply chain challenges within CM/OEM group.
	Recognized multiple times within the business unit for proactively identifying and resolving major supply issues before they impacted the business or customers.
	Execute robust and innovative strategies to drive business growth including identifying 3 new sources of a key chemical compound currently in shortage, qualifying suppliers, and onboarding 80% faster than average.
	Directing a tactical packaging project that’s accountable for $2.3M of product per week to improve availability and mitigate customer delays.

subComponents.title: Senior Engineering Manager - CVG Supply Management
subComponents.caption: Jul 2018 - Oct 2020 · 2 yrs 3 mos

description.text:
Directed a cross-functional Cardiac and Vascular Group (CVG) supplier change control (SCC) transformation team of 63 tasked to develop and release the CVG SCC SOP utilizing risk-based tiering that impacted 4.5K+ users. Sourcing representative on the CVG Supply Management Council.
	Proposed and implemented a new solution for the SCC process to drive greater management and efficiency.
	Decreased a backlog of supplier change control requests by 29% in 18 months.
	Analyzed and evolved the key compliance training module, reducing training by 75% to 2 hours, simplifying materials, and recording the training to increase training availability for global users.
	Oversaw the development and implementation of an automated tool that auto-populated functions into Agile MAP, reducing manual workload and increasing overall data accuracy.

subComponents.title: Supply Management Leader - Aortic and Coronary Supply Management
subComponents.caption: Feb 2018 - Jul 2018 · 5 mos

description.text:
Positioned to tackle large-scale business challenge, supporting Aortic and Coronary supply management including site performance, factory stabilization, quality improvements, employee engagement, and leadership of value streams across three locations of Santa Rosa – CA, Danvers – MA, and Galway – Ireland.
	Oversaw supply management function for a combined $2.4B in revenue, partnering with internal cross-functional teams to determine future capacity requirements for new product launches and suppliers to deliver on capacity goals.
	Solved business challenges and drove greater optimization and cost savings through strategic analysis and execution of initiatives, capturing $1M in cost savings within 5 months.
	Directed a cross-functional team to analyze and implement insourcing of a key nitinol component resulting in annual cost savings of $650K.
	Led a refurbishing of existing molds program to reduce new injection molding equipment charges and pivot to a new qualified supplier in Ireland, delivering savings of $350K.
	Identified reorganization challenge and designed/proposed tactical solution to drive greater Supply Management across the 3 locations, pitching solution to leadership that was adopted in July 2018.

subComponents.title: Program Manager/Senior Program Manager/Senior Engineering Manager - Contract Manufacturing
subComponents.caption: Feb 2008 - Feb 2018 · 10 yrs

description.text:
Drove the optimization and growth strategy for the Extracorporeal Therapies (ECT) value stream, managing strategic quality, delivery, and cost initiatives across multiple contract manufacturers with annual spend of $100M+. Directed a continuity engineering team of 16 responsible for supporting MDT internal manufacturing in 4 Medtronic factories.
	Launched an Injection Mold Management program for 500+ molds, developing business processes to evaluate mold performance for quality, delivery, performance, and cost within a value stream with $3.6M in annual spend.
	Drove operational optimization and critical programs, partnering closely with teams to solve business challenges including backorder issues, discontinued materials, and material replacement initiatives.
	Decreased backorders by 75% through the qualification of 2 new PVC dedicated cleanrooms and associated products with a key supplier.
	Achieved zero quality or supply issues with replacements that impacted over 80% of the product line.
	Previously, a Principal Manufacturing Engineer (2004 – 2008) responsible for leading Lean Manufacturing efforts.

Managed multiple special projects within the Cardiac Surgery business, and functioned as Technical Lead for Commodity Opportunities and Leadership Team (COLT).  Also managed Engineering, Facilities, and Reagent groups and co-managed a $4.4M annual operating plan.
•	Drove Lean Manufacturing efforts and process improvements that increased line productivity by greater than 50%, reduced finished goods scrap by $194K/yr, reduced overtime by $50K/yr, and reduced material costs by $160K/yr.
•	Partnered with contract manufacturer to implement Lean Manufacturing principles. Increased line output by 38%, on hand inventory by 50%, and eliminated worldwide backorders of two key product lines.
•	Managed facility relocation of key supplier and re-validated 467 part numbers with no interruptions to Medtronic manufacturing, and no product quality issues.
•	Managed department budgets to exceed 6% annual cost reduction and productivity improvement goals.

Managed internal QC department, and drove quality, delivery and cost improvements with contract manufacturers of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, and Finished Drug Products.
•	Improved on-time release of finished drug product by 60%.
•	Reduced QC Laboratory supplies cost by 34%, and labor costs by 50%.
•	Managed 2 FDA CDER audits of QC function with no findings or recommendations and implemented systems which helped facilitate ISO13485 certification.

Served as an internal consultant that provided a technical resource for materials selection, product development, product release and resolution of manufacturing issues that billed directly to internal customers to meet a zero based budget structure.
•	Served on due diligence team during acquisition of key business unit in Europe, and helped drive harmonization of systems after the acquisition.
•	Prepared ANDA technical files used to gain FDA approval of two drug products.
•	Determined shelf life and short-term stability of drug and dialysate products to permit expiration dating on product labels to comply with 21 CFR Part 211.
